about: Brief 115: the community centre's open-plan office as a referee room, for Linzie's two tests (windows open all winter; passive cooling against a cooling system), run in Engine 2 and in EnergyPlus AirflowNetwork from these inputs. Office size (11 m of south facade, 12 m deep, 3.2 m high), office hours (Mon-Fri 07:00-18:00), heating 21 C with a 16 C setback, cooling 24 C in hours, window rule (open above 22 C in hours), q50 5, suburban, crack exponent 0.67, Gatwick weather, all as the community centre example (scripts/115_community_centre.mts). Differences from the community centre, stated: a stand-alone box (east and west walls outside, floor exposed) with the Brief 104 cooled room's constructions; one gain of 20 W/m2 in hours and 1 W/m2 outside them (radiant 0.3) in place of the people, lighting and equipment profiles; one sliding window per facade, 1.0 m tall in the middle band (south 10 m wide, north 8 m wide), whose openable fraction is the community centre's top-hung window as the engine reads it (30 % of the glass x C(20 deg) = 0.3 x 0.3265 = 0.098); no trickle vents. The window sill follows the 115_air_spec.json note (EnergyPlus takes the centroid as the bottom of a SimpleOpening). Committed before the first run. Read by validation/energyplus/115_office_referee.py and frontend/src/thermal/engine/__tests__/officeBox.ts.
